Where To Get Help & Support
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000649874
We all need support at one time or another, and the great news is we have LOTS of ways to get the support  needed! Below are easy ways to get support.
 | Help Center ArticlesOur knowledge base is filled with great documentation about how the directory software works inside and out! Find questions to common questions as well as advanced documentation for developersGo To Knowledge Center »

 | Customizations & Advanced ChangesHave neat ideas to customize the site? Get free quotes from certified developers at fair prices in the Marketplace. From small changes to total theme makeovers, get the help needed here!Go To Marketplace »

 | Book Private Phone TrainingBecome a directory master by taking advantage of training sessions. Learn how to manage the directory and increase productivity.View Training Topics »


 | Contact Technical SupportCan't find what you are looking for in either of the places above, contact our team directly. We're happy to help!Submit A Ticket »(Fastest Response)OrEmail support@brilliantdirectories.com »(Takes Longer To Process)

## Help Center Articles
Our knowledge base is filled with great documentation about how the directory software works inside and out! Find questions to common questions as well as advanced documentation for developers
Go To Knowledge Center »

## Customizations & Advanced Changes
Have neat ideas to customize the site? Get free quotes from certified developers at fair prices in the Marketplace. From small changes to total theme makeovers, get the help needed here!
Go To Marketplace »

## Book Private Phone Training
Become a directory master by taking advantage of training sessions. Learn how to manage the directory and increase productivity.
View Training Topics »

## Contact Technical Support
Can't find what you are looking for in either of the places above, contact our team directly. We're happy to help!
Submit A Ticket » (Fastest Response)
Email support@brilliantdirectories.com » (Takes Longer To Process)
